declarations.description:
Circular progress indicator. Without a `value` it spins indeterminately; with one it draws the completed arc of a
ring and animates between values. Text in the default slot sits beside it (or below, via a variable) and names the
indicator for assistive technology, as does the `label` attribute. Everything is one SVG ring, so size, thickness,
colours and speed are variables.
declarations.name: Spinner

cssProperties.description: Thickness of the ring, in the ring's 48-unit box; it scales with the size.
cssProperties.name: --c2-spinner--stroke-width

cssProperties.description: Colour of the full ring behind the arc; `transparent` hides it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-spinner__track--color

cssProperties.description: One indeterminate cycle; also the determinate transition length divided by two.
cssProperties.name: --c2-spinner--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Space between the ring and the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-spinner--gap

cssProperties.description: `column` puts the text under the ring.
cssProperties.name: --c2-spinner--flex-direction

slots.description: Optional text shown next to the ring (e.g. "Loading…"). Also used as the accessible name.

members.name: value
members.description: Progress between `0` and `max`. Leave unset for an indeterminate spinner.

members.name: max
members.description: Value that fills the whole ring.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name when nothing is slotted. Defaults to "Loading".

attributes.name: value
